files.source_assessment: HTTP storage changes from major 2/minor 2 at 2026.10.3 to major 3/minor 1 at 2026.11.0. The v3 migration versions SSL profile names in stable and non-null pending configurations; stable/pending/yaml_migration_done/server_port/error semantics remain unchanged. The exact 2026.11.0 lane binding therefore expects HTTP store version 3; prior bindings and 2026.8.0/8.1 retain version 2, and every other HTTP assertion is unchanged. Upgrade consequence: older Core cannot read the migrated v3 store (the 2026.10.3 Store rejects a major version above max_readable_version, defaulting to its own version 2). A binary downgrade alone is not an HTTP-store rollback; a compatible pre-upgrade store/recovery plan is required. Exact sources: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/1f214b8461dd1fbbd66e10765c6905f49d3c1d86/homeassistant/components/http/config.py#L74 (2.2), #L304 (store construction), #L664 (migration); https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/74cf5a49c63ed8d4d87717844bf14f79c28c9cea/homeassistant/components/http/config.py#L75 (3.1), #L184 (SSL name conversion), #L684 and #L724 (v3 migration); https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/1f214b8461dd1fbbd66e10765c6905f49d3c1d86/homeassistant/helpers/storage.py#L277 and #L437 (older-reader refusal).
